products.provenance: no person shall manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale any ... (L) upholstered furniture if such product contains intentionally added PFAS

value: products for which federal law governs or requires the presence of PFAS in the product in a manner that preempts state authority
products regulated under section 22a-903a or 22a-255i of the general statutes
the sale or resale of a used product
